C1385.title: V380 IP Camera Hardcoded Backdoor Vulnerability (CVE-2025-7503)
C1385.summary: A security researcher discovered a hardcoded network service configuration in the firmware of a V380 IP camera, which acts as a hidden backdoor. This allows attackers to gain unauthorized access, steal surveillance footage, or take control of the device. The vulnerability stems from hardcoded credentials embedded during firmware development, representing a classic firmware backdoor.
